responsibility: This is the main declaration and binding-management file for the C front end. It owns construction and processing of C declarations and types, symbol lookup and scope stacks, parser-lifetime front-end state such as statement trees and current-function metadata, handling of declarators, tags, builtins, attributes, and OpenMP reduction declarations, and the end-of-translation-unit wrapup that closes scopes, emits deferred global declarations and Objective-C globals, and frees C-only declaration metadata before handoff to later compilation stages.
